top10.introHtml: Refreshed Nov 28, 2026. After removing 2-seaters (Miata, Z4, Solstice/Sky, SL/SLK, Crossfire, TT, Boxster, 350Z, 124 Spider, Thunderbird, Allante, smart) and the personal exclude list (MINI, Buick, Volvo, Solara, Camaro, pre-2005 Mustang), 17 Cars.com (of 46; 3 beyond 35 mi dropped), 36 CarGurus (of 78; 30 shown) and 35 AutoTrader (of 68 within 35 mi; 30 shown) listings remained. Many cars appear on several sites; each pick uses the cheapest or best-documented copy. Jaguar XJS/XK8, Lexus SC 430, Mitsubishi Eclipse Spyder and Pontiac Firebird were kept as 2+2 four-seaters. Changes vs. yesterday: the Deptford G37 is gone (replaced by a 2012 G37 on AutoTrader), the 2008 135i dropped to $11,750, and several dealers nudged prices up ~$490. Image coverage: Cars.com 16/17, CarGurus 30/30, AutoTrader 30/30. TrueCar skipped (broken body-style filter).

picks.whyGood: The 135i's twin-turbo N54 inline-six makes this one of the most fun 4-seat convertibles in budget, and the listing's equipment list shows a 6-speed manual. 75,522 miles, power-folding lined soft top with heated glass rear window, 22 miles away in Willow Grove.
picks.whatToVerify: Cycle the top fully several times (watch for hesitation or uneven latching); check headliner, carpet and trunk for water stains; inspect the rear-window seam and seals; look for rocker and floor rust. BMW: N54 high-pressure fuel pump and wastegate rattle, electric water pump/thermostat, oil filter housing and valve cover gasket leaks, soft-top hydraulic ram/lines. Confirm it is actually a 6-speed manual on the test drive.
picks.bottomLine: Best fun-per-dollar pick if the N54 checks out — a manual, turbo six, 4-seat drop-top under $13k.

picks.whyGood: S197 Mustang GT with the 4.6 V8 and only 80,750 miles, power soft top, 10 miles from Media in West Chester. No accidents reported on the listing. Mustangs are cheap to fix and parts are everywhere.
picks.whatToVerify: Cycle the top fully several times (watch for hesitation or uneven latching); check headliner, carpet and trunk for water stains; inspect the rear-window seam and seals; look for rocker and floor rust. Mustang: 8.8 axle clunk on takeoff, 3-valve 4.6 cam-phaser rattle at idle, spring-perch rust, top-latch wear, water staining on the rear seats. This one is a 5-speed automatic.
picks.bottomLine: The V8 Mustang to beat — low miles, close by, and the most character in the band.

picks.whyGood: Lexus SC 430 retractable hardtop — no fabric to tear and a famously durable 4.3 V8 drivetrain. 113,877 miles at $13,342, no accidents reported on the listing, 29 miles away in Gilbertsville.
picks.whatToVerify: Cycle the top fully several times (watch for hesitation or uneven latching); check headliner, carpet and trunk for water stains; inspect the rear-window seam and seals; look for rocker and floor rust. SC 430: cycle the folding hardtop and listen for pump strain, check the roof hydraulic lines/cylinders for leaks, run-flat tire wear, dash and leather condition, timing-belt service records (due ~90k).
picks.bottomLine: The low-stress choice: Lexus reliability with a metal roof, if you can live with a small back seat.

picks.whyGood: First-year 135i with only 48,371 miles — twin-turbo N54 thrills at a modest price, now down to $11,750. CarGurus Good Deal, 23 miles away in Turnersville NJ. Transmission not stated in the listing — ask the seller.
picks.whatToVerify: Cycle the top fully several times (watch for hesitation or uneven latching); check headliner, carpet and trunk for water stains; inspect the rear-window seam and seals; look for rocker and floor rust. BMW: N54 HPFP and injector history, wastegate rattle, water pump, oil filter housing gasket, soft-top hydraulic ram. Ask whether it is manual or automatic.
picks.bottomLine: Very low miles for a 135i — worth a look if service records exist.

picks.whyGood: 2014 Mustang V6 — the 305-hp 3.7 Ti-VCT is reliable and quick, the last-year S197 sorted most early issues. 109,452 miles, no accidents and clean title per Cars.com filters.
picks.whatToVerify: Cycle the top fully several times (watch for hesitation or uneven latching); check headliner, carpet and trunk for water stains; inspect the rear-window seam and seals; look for rocker and floor rust. Mustang: 8.8 axle clunk, spring-perch and rear-subframe rust, top-latch wear, rear-seat water staining from top seals, 3.7 water-pump weep.

picks.whyGood: E46 330Ci with just 64,358 miles — the classic, simple BMW drop-top with the smooth M54 six. No accidents and clean title per Cars.com filters, $9,495.
picks.whatToVerify: Cycle the top fully several times (watch for hesitation or uneven latching); check headliner, carpet and trunk for water stains; inspect the rear-window seam and seals; look for rocker and floor rust. E46: cooling system (radiator, expansion tank, water pump), subframe mounting cracks, oil filter housing and valve cover leaks, soft-top hydraulic pump and flap motors, window regulators.
picks.bottomLine: Low-mile E46 at an under-$10k price — a great cheap-fun baseline.

picks.whyGood: Audi A5 2.0T Premium Plus Cabriolet with 86,962 miles, Cars.com Great Deal, 18 miles away in Oaklyn NJ. No accidents and clean title per Cars.com filters.
picks.whatToVerify: Cycle the top fully several times (watch for hesitation or uneven latching); check headliner, carpet and trunk for water stains; inspect the rear-window seam and seals; look for rocker and floor rust. Audi: 2.0T oil consumption (piston ring update) and timing-chain tensioner, PCV valve, water pump, transmission service history, top-drain clogs.
picks.bottomLine: Upscale, comfortable cabriolet at a fair price — verify oil consumption.

picks.whyGood: INFINITI G37 retractable hardtop with the stout 3.7-liter VQ37 V6 (~325 hp) — a metal roof and a usable back seat. About 83,000 miles, no accidents reported on the AutoTrader listing, 27 miles from Media. Replaces yesterday's Deptford G37, which is no longer listed.
picks.whatToVerify: Cycle the top fully several times (watch for hesitation or uneven latching); check headliner, carpet and trunk for water stains; inspect the rear-window seam and seals; look for rocker and floor rust. G37: cycle the 3-piece hardtop (sensor/latch faults), trunk-area hydraulic leaks, VQ37 oil consumption and gallery gasket (2008-2012), rear-seat water stains.
picks.bottomLine: Solid modern hardtop pick near the top of the budget — negotiate toward $13k.

picks.whyGood: Jaguar XJS 4.0 convertible (2+2) with only about 46,000 miles at $7,999 — the cheapest way into a grand-touring classic. No accidents reported on the listing, 21 miles away in Magnolia NJ.
picks.whatToVerify: Cycle the top fully several times (watch for hesitation or uneven latching); check headliner, carpet and trunk for water stains; inspect the rear-window seam and seals; look for rocker and floor rust. XJS: rust in sills, jacking points and rear arches; top frame and motor; cooling system; electrics; AJ16 head gasket and oil leaks. Get a Jaguar-specialist PPI.
picks.bottomLine: A low-mile classic GT for the price of a tired Sebring — buy on condition only.

picks.whyGood: 2016 Audi A3 2.0T Premium cabriolet — the newest car in the top 10, 84,000 miles, private seller 16 miles away, no accidents and clean title per Cars.com filters.
picks.whatToVerify: Cycle the top fully several times (watch for hesitation or uneven latching); check headliner, carpet and trunk for water stains; inspect the rear-window seam and seals; look for rocker and floor rust. Audi A3: S-tronic (DSG) service history, water pump/thermostat housing leak, carbon buildup, top-drain clogs. Ask the private seller for records.
picks.bottomLine: Modern, efficient pick with the fewest years on it.

manual10.introHtml: Only one confirmed manual surfaced this refresh: the 2011 BMW 135i in Willow Grove (6-speed per its AutoTrader equipment list), now $12,990. The 2008 135i (48k mi, $11,750) does not state its transmission — ask the seller. Most listings don't report transmission, so a few more manuals may be hiding in the lists.

picks.whyGood: The 135i's twin-turbo N54 inline-six makes this one of the most fun 4-seat convertibles in budget, and the listing's equipment list shows a 6-speed manual. 75,522 miles, power-folding lined soft top with heated glass rear window, 22 miles away in Willow Grove.
picks.whatToVerify: Cycle the top fully several times (watch for hesitation or uneven latching); check headliner, carpet and trunk for water stains; inspect the rear-window seam and seals; look for rocker and floor rust. BMW: N54 high-pressure fuel pump and wastegate rattle, electric water pump/thermostat, oil filter housing and valve cover gasket leaks, soft-top hydraulic ram/lines. Confirm it is actually a 6-speed manual on the test drive. Manual: clutch engagement point (high bite = worn clutch), 2nd/3rd synchro slow-shift test, throw-out bearing chirp, clutch hydraulics weeping.
picks.bottomLine: Best fun-per-dollar pick if the N54 checks out — a manual, turbo six, 4-seat drop-top under $13k.

mustangs.introHtml: Six distinct 2005+ Mustang convertibles in budget (several cross-listed): two 2010 GT V8s in West Chester and four V6 cars. Ranked GT first, then mileage and distance.

picks.whyGood: S197 Mustang GT with the 4.6 V8 and only 80,750 miles, power soft top, 10 miles from Media in West Chester. No accidents reported on the listing. Mustangs are cheap to fix and parts are everywhere.
picks.whatToVerify: Cycle the top fully several times (watch for hesitation or uneven latching); check headliner, carpet and trunk for water stains; inspect the rear-window seam and seals; look for rocker and floor rust. Mustang (S197): 3-valve 4.6 cam-phaser rattle on 05-10 GTs, spring-perch rust, top-latch wear; 8.8 axle clunk on takeoff; water staining on rear seats from top-seal failure.
picks.bottomLine: The V8 Mustang to beat — low miles, close by, and the most character in the band.

picks.whyGood: Another 2010 GT V8 in West Chester, 9 miles away, at $11,975 — cheaper, with 132,158 miles.
picks.whatToVerify: Cycle the top fully several times (watch for hesitation or uneven latching); check headliner, carpet and trunk for water stains; inspect the rear-window seam and seals; look for rocker and floor rust. Mustang (S197): 3-valve 4.6 cam-phaser rattle on 05-10 GTs, spring-perch rust, top-latch wear; 8.8 axle clunk on takeoff; water staining on rear seats from top-seal failure. High mileage: check the transmission and rear-main seal.
picks.bottomLine: Cheaper V8 if the higher miles have been looked after.

picks.whyGood: 2014 Mustang V6 — the 305-hp 3.7 Ti-VCT is reliable and quick, the last-year S197 sorted most early issues. 109,452 miles, no accidents and clean title per Cars.com filters.
picks.whatToVerify: Cycle the top fully several times (watch for hesitation or uneven latching); check headliner, carpet and trunk for water stains; inspect the rear-window seam and seals; look for rocker and floor rust. Mustang (S197): spring-perch rust, top-latch wear; 8.8 axle clunk on takeoff; water staining on rear seats from top-seal failure. 3.7 V6: water-pump weep.

picks.whatToVerify: Cycle the top fully several times (watch for hesitation or uneven latching); check headliner, carpet and trunk for water stains; inspect the rear-window seam and seals; look for rocker and floor rust. picks.whyGood: 2014 V6 at $9,142 — CarGurus Great Deal, 121,010 miles, Gilbertsville.
picks.whatToVerify: Cycle the top fully several times (watch for hesitation or uneven latching); check headliner, carpet and trunk for water stains; inspect the rear-window seam and seals; look for rocker and floor rust. Mustang (S197): spring-perch rust, top-latch wear; 8.8 axle clunk on takeoff; water staining on rear seats from top-seal failure.
picks.bottomLine: Cheapest sensible Mustang ticket in the band.
